Rationale for Rethinking Well-being Team Training

Training completion ≠ readiness to perform. Having managed teacher training over the years, I feel our training needs to assess what a person can actually do, not just what they have read or understood.

The current module has useful content, including counseling essentials, referral processes, case studies, observations, Life Classes and documentation.

However, much of the evidence is currently based on reading, written reflections, planning and task completion rather than demonstrated practice.

AI makes this gap more significant. Reflections, case responses, counseling plans and written submissions can easily be generated with AI, without demonstrating whether the trainee can actually handle a student situation.

Currently, there is no defined percentage-based competency rubric to consistently measure overall training completion/readiness.

There is also no final graduation/readiness demonstration where the trainee brings together their learning and demonstrates professional judgement.

For a Well-being role, knowledge alone is not enough. We need to see the trainee demonstrate listening, judgement, boundaries, confidentiality, intervention, documentation, collaboration and appropriate escalation.
column3:
Recommendations:

- New counselors to undergo "Trauma Informed Intervention" and "Motivational Interviewing" certifications. The certification fees to be borne by the school if possible. (Add training link and cost)
* https://connectandrestore.in/trauma-informed-training - Online, 7 days, 6pm to 9pm (3 hours/day), Rs 7000-8000

- New counselors to have a supervisor mandatorily (at least one meeting with the supervisor per month). The counselors can choose an external supervisor (entire cost borne by the counselor or a fixed amount deducted from the salary which is credited to the supervisor's account) or the school can hire a supervisor that conducts online/offline session on staff working Saturdays.

- Exam monitoring system developed by the COE students can be used for assessment (interview + graduation) to monitor use of AI.

- Recordings of the sessions of 3-4 students to evaluate the technical skills, in cases where the students don't want more than one person to be in the room.

- CPP and post-vention SOP to be added to training manual.
